facts.fact: The Namibian reports that the Ministry of ICT launched the national ICT policy at Opuwo, with the minister saying it would guide the ICT sector over the next five years; the launch day is given only as 'Thursday', so the article date is the anchor.
The Namibian reports that the national ICT policy sets out clear roles for the institutions responsible for implementing and monitoring ICT development; no budget line is stated.
The national ICT policy was launched by the ICT minister in January 2026, as reported by The Namibian on 2026-01-29.

note: Passages hold only the contents list, acronyms and definitions of the Ministry's own strategic plan (institution-plan class); no sector policy fact.
A service charter of the OPM IT sub-division; says it implements government ICT policy but names no sector policy, its standing, text or period.

facts.fact: The National Broadband Policy gazetted 14 August 2020 (published year-dated; the policy itself is a broadband subsector instrument) says it is built on and supports the objectives of the Overarching ICT Policy 2009, which it treats as in place; the document does not describe that policy's scope.

note: The broadband policy itself is a subsector instrument and gives no fact; the passages end before its implementation sections.
Regional regulators' forum report; names Namibia only as a participating regulator and states nothing on a Namibian sector policy.
Regional regulators' peer exchange in Nairobi; Namibia's regulator CRAN attends, but no ICT sector policy of Namibia is stated.

facts.fact: The ITU repository lists Namibia's National ICT Policy / Broadband Policy, owned by the Ministry of ICT, with a time frame of 2018 to 2022 (phase); the document gives no event date, so its published year 2025 is used.

The ITU repository lists the National ICT Policy / Broadband Policy among Namibia's strategies with an official policy source and implementation evidence of training programmes; no adoption date is given, so its published year 2025 is used.
Minister Emma Theofelus officially launched the National ICT Policy and the 2025-2030 MICT Strategic Plan on 2026-01-29.
